# DCinside

> DCinside is Korea's largest online community platform connecting millions of users through categorized galleries, forums, and content aggregation across entertainment, sports, gaming, and K-pop.

DCinside operates as a multi-category social platform with major galleries for mainstream topics and minor/mini galleries for niche communities. The platform emphasizes user-generated content, trending discussions, and community moderation to maintain content standards.

## Key Topics

- Korean community
- User-generated content
- K-pop
- Sports discussion
- League of Legends
- Entertainment news
- Trending posts
- Gallery categories
- Community forums
- Content moderation
- Minor galleries
- Social media aggregation
- Gaming communities
- Celebrity profiles
- Streaming content

## Main Galleries & Directories

- [DCinside Main Homepage](https://gall.dcinside.com): Primary entry point featuring multi-category galleries, trending posts, and community forums across entertainment, sports, gaming, and K-pop content
- [Minor Gallery Directory](https://gall.dcinside.com/m): User-created and niche community galleries covering games, entertainment, and specialized interest groups
- [Mini Gallery Section](https://gall.dcinside.com/n): Streaming, VTuber, and content aggregation galleries for digital media and influencer communities
- [Person Gallery Directory](https://gall.dcinside.com/p): Celebrity and influencer profile galleries featuring K-pop artists, athletes, and public figures

## Community & Moderation

- [Content Reporting & Moderation System](http://gall.dcinside.com/singo): Platform for reporting inappropriate content and maintaining community standards across all galleries
